additional_concerns: The claims' statements that footnotes 2 and 3 are missing are stale: units da12aecad4e68.u28.3334 and da12aecad4e68.u30.3569 supply them.
Footnote 2 creates a separate resubmission duty; it does not authorize off-channel filing or require a submission-compliance test to evaluate the report's entire history.
The XML claim's schema condition belongs to the separately identified XML transition control; its omission from submission.compliance does not establish failure of that partial control.

node.f75383097facdc52b0ac66f7 adds schema conformity to submission compliance without a resolved typed assignment; schema conformity has source support, but the resulting test answers neither submission.compliance alone nor the complete xml.transition question.
node.a9c7e7d0e802f5a3fdf2abc2 substitutes submission-specific certificate availability for satisfaction of the e-Cert requirement without source support for that equivalence.
node.fc565a946804e1633024b4d3 is mispaired with the channel-compliance claim: its assigned question concerns historical existence of a resubmission trigger.

The source supports the 9:00am operational launch and separate blackout contact arrangement, but supplies no explicit timezone or certificate-use mechanics; externally supplied classifications must preserve those unresolved dependencies.
